title: agentshark portable trace (.aspark) v2
description: Versioned JSON schema for a session export produced by `agentshark export` and read by `agentshark inspect --replay`. Matches AsparkFile in src/export/pack.ts. v2 adds a 'children' array bundling sub-agent sessions and preserves per-turn 'turnUsage' on events. v1 files (no 'children') remain loadable by --replay; see schema/aspark.v1.json for that legacy shape.

asparkVersion.description: Schema version, as a string. Bumped on breaking changes.

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this file was produced.

exportedBy.description: Tool + version that produced the file, e.g. 'agentshark-tui'.

redaction.description: Summary of redaction applied before export.

patternsApplied.description: Names of pattern matchers that ran (e.g. 'api_key', 'jwt', 'secret').

events.description: Chronologically-ordered event stream for the exported (parent) session.

children.description: Descendant sub-agent sessions bundled into this export, each with its own event stream. Omitted entirely for a single-session export.

Event.description: Mirrors Partial<AgentEvent> from src/schema/event.ts. Fields marked required here are those `extractEvents` always populates; the type is a Partial so older/hand-built replay fixtures may omit them.

traceId.description: Session id this event belongs to.

spanId.description: Unique identifier for this event within the trace.

parentSpanId.description: If nested (e.g. sub-agent inside orchestrator), the parent span's id.

detail.description: Short human-readable summary shown in the event list.

payload.description: Full event-specific payload after redaction. NEVER carries unredacted secret content.

category.description: Internal category bucket used by the Context Composition view.

turnUsage.description: Per-turn usage object set on 'api_turn' events; preserved through export so Context Composition can be recomputed on replay.
